classification_definitions.exact_match: The backend value or sequence agrees directly with the frozen manufacturer baseline.
classification_definitions.functionally_equivalent: The backend uses a different implementation form while preserving the manufacturer-required effect.
classification_definitions.backend_optimization: Backend-specific optimization not required by the manufacturer programming semantics.
classification_definitions.backend_assumption_or_default: Backend operational constraint/default that is not an IC specification.
classification_definitions.manufacturer_unresolved_backend_value: Backend supplies a value where the locked manufacturer baseline intentionally remains unknown.
classification_definitions.conflict_or_out_of_spec: Backend/board convenience contradicts or exceeds the exact-ICPN manufacturer specification.
classification_definitions.backend_extra_requires_manufacturer_vali: Useful backend behavior not modeled in the frozen baseline and not eligible for native adoption without manufacturer evidence.

observations.manufacturer: FLASH interface base 0x40022000 with ACR/KEYR/OPTKEYR/SR/CR/AR/OBR/WRPR offsets 0x00/04/08/0C/10/14/1C/20.
observations.openocd: Uses the same base and offsets.

observations.manufacturer: Unlock only when needed, perform operation, then lock.
observations.openocd: Writes KEY1/KEY2 before erase/write and writes FLASH_LOCK at operation exit.

observations.manufacturer: No RAM-loader requirement in the frozen programming semantics.
observations.openocd: Uploads stm32f1x flash loader into target working RAM and uses an async FIFO/block-write algorithm; falls back when working area is unavailable.

observations.manufacturer: Frozen manufacturer baseline does not define 'OpenOCD target halted' as an IC programming electrical/flash requirement.
observations.openocd: Erase/write/protection paths reject operations unless TARGET_HALTED.

observations.manufacturer: Frozen baseline has no numeric software timeout policy.

openocd.rationale: JTAG <= F_CPU/6; reset CPU assumed 8 MHz, therefore choose 1 MHz

observations.manufacturer: Frozen reference flow requires readback/erase verification as an explicit programming-flow step.
observations.openocd: Low-level stm32f1x erase/write driver performs Flash operations and status/error checks; readback/blank verification is provided as separate framework/program flow rather than embedded in each low-level driver operation.

observations.manufacturer: Exact ICPN identity is not inferred from a family Device ID in the frozen baseline.
observations.openocd: Reads DBGMCU ID at 0xE0042000; 0x410 identifies STM32F10x medium-density class and also contains special handling for several GD32 revisions.

observations.manufacturer: Exact STM32F103C8T6 profile fixes main Flash at 64 KiB.
observations.openocd: Reads Flash-size register at 0x1FFFF7E0; if read fails/returns invalid for device ID 0x410, falls back to family maximum 128 KiB.

openocd.warning: may operate a particular C8 board outside its specification

observations.manufacturer: STM32F103C8T6 baseline describes ST silicon only.
observations.openocd: The shared stm32f1x driver recognizes GD32-related revision IDs and applies variant-specific behavior.
